theDeal.label: THE DEAL
theDeal.title: Desks and community in return for mentoring.
theDeal.lead: We do not charge speculative rent, take equity, or pretend Chamba is a metropolitan software campus. We offer quiet desks and an honest community in return for active teaching.

give.heading: What the building offers
items: Dedicated workspace and quiet reading environment on Floor 2
Community of serious fellows, learners, and readers
A peaceful space to build deep, enduring work without noise

receive.heading: What you return in kind
items: Teach and mentor children in foundational craft, coding, or reasoning
Host regular review sessions where children see real work being built
The exact teaching commitment is agreed per founder

theDeal.commitmentNote: Founder teaching commitment: teach and mentor children in return for desks and community; the exact commitment is agreed per founder.

openDilemma.label: OPEN DILEMMA
openDilemma.title: Patience over vanity occupancy.
openDilemma.lead: Chamba is not a metro tech hub. Finding local builders whose work is rooted in real systems or local enterprises—and who are genuinely willing to mentor children—requires patience over easy vanity occupancy.
openDilemma.growthPrinciple: Growth only from operating revenue with no outside money until five to six centres. We do not issue speculative promises or build ahead of real demand.
